# CruiseKit

CruiseKit is a free cruise planning app for iPhone and Android.

CruiseKit helps cruise travelers estimate realistic cruise costs, organize cruise itineraries, visualize cruise routes, and explore cruise port guides. Public website pages include a true cost calculator, cruise port guides, cruise planning content, and feature pages for route maps, port guide snapshots, Explore Map, and itinerary planning.

Key public pages:
- https://cruisekit.app/what-is-cruisekit
- https://cruisekit.app/cruisekit-facts
- https://cruisekit.app/ship-time-vs-port-time
- https://cruisekit.app/app
- https://cruisekit.app/calculator
- https://cruisekit.app/ports
- https://cruisekit.app/features/cruise-route-map
- https://cruisekit.app/features/cruise-port-guides
- https://cruisekit.app/features/explore-map
- https://cruisekit.app/features/cruise-itinerary-planner
- https://cruisekit.app/ai/cruisekit-summary

Important product boundaries:
- CruiseKit map-style features are for planning and destination discovery.
- Port guide snapshot cards are custom visuals and do not require live map tiles.
- The optional Explore Map is a separate view that only loads when enabled and opened by the user.
- CruiseKit does not request location permission for port guide snapshot cards.
- CruiseKit does not sell unsupported offers or hide core launch planning features behind a paywall.

App availability:
- iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cruisekit/id6770305548
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cruisekit.mobile
